features: 205MB/s max read speed expedites transfers and reduces wait times

description: The Lexar Professional SILVER PLUS microSDXC UHS-I Card delivers 205MB/s max read and 150MB/s max write speeds to help you capture better photos and videos and to accelerate your workflow. Rated V30, it records 4K video at 60FPS for stunning, stutter-free footage. It’s water-, temperature-, x-ray-, vibration-, magnetic-, shock-, wear-, and dropproof and it comes with a lifetime limited warranty for maximum peace of mind.
